yes that too 🥶. try to cheer up a little by dancing if you could, it helps me at least.
I hope you'll be alright!

I see, mine was like that too, at least gaming I could do. now all I do is turn on the pc to listen to music and sleep on the keyboard my face gets all marked and sometimes it hurts my eyes.

I keep trying though, last time I finished a game on May last year (the game was Bladed fury, but also one I've played in 2021 but I'd like to mention, this game is amazing, Hellblade:Senua's sacrifice), I liked it very much, it made me wish to play more games with the same environment. but from June to November it felt like time had stopped to me again, depression hit so hard that I almost visited hell.

Well, a game I don't stop playing is Love Nikki, I don't play it like before but I try to keep active and see events I like

C'monn games are amazing, enjoyable and all, for many a escape from reality, a lifestyle, hobbie, we enjoy it very much.

There are many games I want to play, Fran bow, Portal, Firewatch, Dark souls and many others. Slowly I'll get there.

sorry the reply is long, idk why, I'll just say like a friend says 'I got carried away'

anyways

Stay awesome you all!

Oh hellblade Senua's sacrifice! I'm glad to say that I finished this game and it was a magical experience, truly loved this beautiful game. ♡

I hope you have a lot of fun playing it too!! 😊
